title: Eigenoid and RiskMandate

scenes.kicker: RiskMandate · a story made at the summit
scenes.title: Eigenoid and RiskMandate
scenes.caption: For Eigenoid

scenes.text: When one team's agent asks another team's agent, the exchange can be evidenced. The endpoints are a second question.
scenes.caption: The angle in one line: two kinds of evidence, one boundary.
say: Eigenoid lets one team's agent consult the specialist agent of the team that owns the answer.
Our suggestion is a joint offer that evidences both the exchange and the endpoints.

scenes.title: What Eigenoid does between agents
steps: One team's agent needs an answer another team owns
It finds the owning team's agent in the registry
Owning team decides what is shared and what needs sign-off
scenes.caption: People step in only for questions that need a human.
say: One registry lists agents wherever they run: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, on-premises.
Each listing has an owner, team, environment and status.

scenes.text: "Connecting agents does not contain their runtimes."
scenes.caption: The endpoints' tools, permissions and security remain part of the boundary.
say: This is Eigenoid's own line, and it is honest.
It marks the part a connection does not contain.

scenes.title: Two halves of one boundary

before.label: Eigenoid: the exchange
items: Identity, authorization decisions, policy versions, delegation and human approvals (Enterprise)

after.label: RiskMandate: each endpoint
items: What its credentials and tools actually reach
Measured per agent, on either side of the exchange

scenes.caption: Eigenoid evidences the exchange; RiskMandate measures mandate, reach and gap.
say: Eigenoid's side comes from its public pages.
RiskMandate's side is what we would do together, not a claim by Eigenoid.

scenes.title: Mandate, reach and gap for a listed agent
rows: Listing says what it answers and may share
Mandate against the agent's actual setup
Own tools and permissions; not in the registry
What its credentials and tools reach
Shared via Eigenoid vs. reachable by other paths
scenes.caption: Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
say: The gap is unknown from public pages, and measurable per agent.
That is where we would work together.

scenes.title: A natural fit with Eigenoid's own review
items: Eigenoid's readiness review: 45 minutes, one workflow where two agents share context
Output: a one-page gap report mapped to EU AI Act Articles 9, 12, 14, 15, 17, 19, 26 and 72
It says it does not certify compliance
Its published limits: implementation findings, not an independent security audit
No external user has yet validated a substantive Connect task (as of 6 September 2026)
Our suggestion: add the endpoint view to that same workflow
scenes.caption: Eigenoid publishes its limits; an endpoint measurement would add what a connection does not contain.
say: The first five points are Eigenoid's own public facts.
The last is our suggestion for a joint start.
scenes.source: Eigenoid public pages, as of 6 September 2026

scenes.text: Eigenoid evidences the exchange. RiskMandate measures each endpoint. Together, both are evidenced.
scenes.caption: Our suggestion, built from public pages only.
say: A connection does not contain the runtimes, so we measure what it does not.
We would like to test this with you on one workflow.
